ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Revolving Credit Facility and Term A Loan Facility)
ratios.quote: The maximum Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio must be no higher than 4.50 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The filing gives only the 4.50x maximum Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, not the actual ratio. It says the company was in compliance with its financial covenants as of September 30, 2026. The Credit Agreement also requires a minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio, but no limit or actual figure is given, so it is not listed. Excluded: the 3.00x Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio (an accordion incremental-capacity test), the leverage-based pricing grid for margins and fees, the excess cash flow sweep thresholds, and the 2.0x fixed charge coverage incurrence test in the senior note indentures.
